name: -10 AN 90° Degree Bulkhead Fitting
title: -10 AN 90° Degree Bulkhead Fitting
description:
The -10 AN 90° Degree Bulkhead Fitting is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings -10AN 90° Degree Bulkhead Fittings are precision CNC-machined adapters designed to route AN lines at a 90-degree angle through firewalls, panels, fuel cells, and chassis components. Engineered for high-performance fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, brake, and power steering systems, these AN bulkhead fittings provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal on both sides of the panel.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
